visualCharacteristics: Default: full-bleed photo (78vh) with a dark shade and the full-hero overlay PNG, white h1 at the bottom-left (home page).

compact: short page banner (~370px at 1280px), h1 near the top-left, photo on the left fading into a navy (#1e3263) swoop with sky-blue curved lines over the right half, drawn as an inline SVG instead of the overlay PNG.
usage: Page-opening banner. Use the default on the home page; use Hero (compact) for interior page titles such as Who We Are.
reuseGuidance: Row 1 holds the background picture, row 2 the heading. Add (compact) for the short interior banner with the navy swoop.
